## SAT.asVap() method

Create a VAP from this sat

This creates a Concrete VAP by using the first defined product in the derivedFrom property

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
asVap(): VAP;
```
<b>Returns:</b>

[VAP](./environmentals.vap.md)
